description:
Design a new prompt-manager team that owns the inbound side of the Community Contribution Loop. Covers: team roster (how many agents, responsibilities), team.json fields, TEAM.md charter, HEARTBEAT.md, RESPONSIBILITIES.md, skill references, objectives/kpis/consumers/contributions (per team schema v2 if landed).

Central design question: the rejection → working-notebook → plan-of-record promotion flow. Which agent updates the notebook on rejection? Which agent distills it into plan-of-record updates? On what cadence? How does the plan-of-record get shipped out as part of project updates so customer-side classifiers/submitters inherit updated guidance?

Deliverable: conclusion.md with team charter draft, agent responsibility matrix, and the full learning-loop state machine.
name: contribution-triage-team-design
title: Design inbound triage team for community submissions
